qualification.scope: All 576 positions, 384 complete native families, raw/summary telemetry and source seals. Hidden atoms, model multiplicity and objective priorities retained. No hidden-clingo comparison, solver correctness proof or causal performance claim. Timed worker phases may overlap; RSS is separate child accounting. Source revisions are manifest declarations whose build correspondence must be qualified externally.

protocol.name: instrumented_derived_workload_matrix_v2
protocol.statistics: enabled for every native capture; host instrumentation and output included
protocol.aggregation: rows contain per-leg medians of seven timed captures and two separate RSS captures; ranges are retained timed minima/maxima

interpretation.whole_process: Eager-case paired median changes range from -0.52% to +0.25%; no established performance equivalence.
interpretation.dense_grounding: All dense paired grounding medians increase, by 1.69% to 4.42%; rule-instantiation work is unchanged. Cause not isolated.
interpretation.memory: All native paired RSS medians increase by approximately 0.10 to 0.39 MiB; attribution not established.
interpretation.lazy_control: Chain1000 uses lazy_interleaved closure; its CPU4 B1 wall improvement does not repeat in B2.
limits: No hidden-clingo atom comparison or whole-solver proof.
Source/executable build correspondence is qualified separately from declared source identities.
Logical work counters do not count every instruction; no schedule/control-check causal attribution.
Nested phase medians and worker-accumulated time are not additive process wall time.
This is a comparison against the post-row-lending baseline, not a third pre-row-lending build.
